name: The Coastal Blue Formula – Paint, Furniture & Decor Guide
description:
The Coastal Blue Formula – Paint, Furniture & Decor Guide

Create the calm, timeless coastal blue bedroom you have been dreaming of with The Coastal Blue Formula by Deevaya Home. This downloadable room guide is designed to help you recreate the soft, elegant feeling of a beautifully layered American bedroom—without spending hours trying to identify every color, furniture style, and decor detail on your own.

Inside this guide, you will discover a thoughtfully curated combination of coastal blue paint tones, warm neutrals, classic furniture inspiration, lighting ideas, textiles, and decorative details that work beautifully together. From the soothing wall color and crisp white bedding to coordinating nightstands, lamps, pillows, rugs, and finishing touches, every element has been selected to help you achieve a cohesive and inviting look.

What You’ll Find Inside

  • Curated coastal blue paint color inspiration
  • Approximate color names, undertones, and HEX codes
  • Close paint-color suggestions from popular U.S. brands
  • Coordinating furniture styles and product details
  • Bedding, lighting, rug, and decor inspiration
  • Helpful ideas for recreating a similar bedroom look
  • A beautifully designed downloadable PDF guide

This guide is perfect for homeowners, renters, home decor lovers, and anyone who wants to create a peaceful coastal-inspired bedroom with an elegant American-home feel.

Digital Product

This is a digital PDF download. No physical product will be shipped. After your purchase is completed, you will receive access to download the guide.

Important Color Note

Paint colors may appear different depending on your screen, room lighting, wall surface, and surroundings. The colors included in this guide are carefully selected visual recommendations and close matches. Always test a paint sample in your own room before purchasing a full-size container.

Bring home the warmth, softness, and timeless beauty of your favorite Deevaya bedroom with one easy-to-follow room formula.
